judge.note: The official judge is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (openai). Execution requires the key in $OPENAI_API_KEY, installed ragas+datasets+langchain-openai, and an explicitly approved execution phase. The judge model must stay fixed across all scored evaluations.

note: Scored measurement artifact. Group = tuning profile_id or main config_name. Feeds prepare_parameter_freeze.py.

merge.rule: pass1 values preferred; null cells (transient judge timeouts/5xx) filled from the identical pass2 retry. Same judge provider/model/metric set enforced.
